violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. - Cook staff did not wash hands prior to washing hands.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. - Salt seasoning found on shelf without covering.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - All contact surfaces in kitchen need to be cleaned, Prep coolers, reach-in coolers, all handles of all equipment, bottoms of all equipment on cook line.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floor in walk-in freezer needs to be cleaned. - Floor under dishwasher need to be cleaned
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. - Staff not washing hands prior to gloving.
